findings: Login renders without overflow and with 44px targets at five viewport widths
Failed sign-in displays a recoverable error and preserves email
New device requires emailed code and resend is throttled
Expired and incorrect email codes cannot authenticate
Password and emailed code complete the actual browser sign-in flow
Login ticket is single-use and successful sign-in audited
Mobile navigation traps keyboard focus and closes with Escape
Real WebAuthn registration with required user verification succeeds
Real WebAuthn authentication opens an authorized workspace
A signed-in staff account has no operational or owner access before explicit grants
Individual grants persist and finance screen cannot be delegated
Permission changes apply to existing sessions and staff inventory JSON excludes buying costs
Individual permission editor saves grants through its actual browser controls
Server-backed workspace lock blocks subsequent authenticated requests
Revoke ends access on the next API request
Three failures lock the account and alert the owner
limitations: Virtual authenticator validates WebAuthn protocol, not physical Face ID hardware.
Email uses a test-process transport; live provider delivery not exercised.
